# Temple Scroll Column 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 9 | **Condition:** Fragmentary; Wood Offering Festival continues

---

**9:1** [...] on the third day, Simeon and Benjamin [...]

**9:2** [...] on the fourth day, Issachar and Zebulun [...]

**9:3** [...] on the fifth day, Gad and Asher [...]

**9:4** [...] on the sixth day, Dan and Naphtali [...]

**9:5** [...] and they shall bring wood for the altar [...]

**9:6** [...] each tribe shall bring [...] on the day of its allotted portion [...]

**9:7** [...] and the priests and the Levites shall place it upon the fire [...]

**9:8** [...] upon the altar of the burnt offering [...]

**9:9** [...] this is the day of the wood [offering ...] a statute forever [...]

**9:10** [...] throughout your generations [...] before the LORD [...]

**9:11** [...] fire shall not go out upon the altar [...]

**9:12** [...] it shall burn continually [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Column 9 completes the six-day wood offering roster. Consensus follows LOGOS, with the tribal pairs listed straightforwardly. The perpetual fire mandate (lines 11-12) echoes Lev 6:13. LOGOS's "fire shall not go out" is preferred over PNEUMA's expanded "must never be allowed to go out."*
